entry.title: Membership
entry.lead: Following the page gives you its news. Joining means asking to become a member of the association: its officers accept your request or not.
entry.unavailable: Association membership is not available here yet.
entry.memberSince: You have been a member since {{date}}.
entry.pending: Request sent on {{date}}. The association's officers will answer it.
entry.previousRejected: Your previous request was not accepted.
entry.removed: The officers removed you from this association.
entry.readmissionAllowed: They allow you to submit a new request.
entry.notManaged: This association has no team on DIASPORALE yet: no request can be handled for now.
entry.rejoinBlocked: A new request is only possible with the agreement of the association's officers.
entry.tooSoon: You can submit a new request from {{date}}.
entry.statusInsufficient: To ask to join, your DIASPORALE membership must first be declared.

requestSheet.title: Become a member
requestSheet.description: Your request goes to the association's officers. They see your published profile and your note, never your contact details.
requestSheet.free: Joining on DIASPORALE is free. Any membership fee is settled directly with the association and never opens paid access to the network.

leaveConfirm.title: Leave the association?
leaveConfirm.body: You will no longer be one of its members. A new request will remain possible.

feedback.requested: Your request has been sent to the officers.

unavailable.title: Associations are not available here.
unavailable.body: This data provider does not serve association membership yet.

members.title: Members and requests
members.lead: Only the association's officers can see this list. It is not a legal register of members.

roleNote.admin: As a page administrator, you handle requests and manage members.
roleNote.signatory: As a page signatory, you handle requests. Removing a member, naming a coordinator or allowing a new request is up to an administrator.

empty.accepted: No member yet. Every membership starts with a person's own request: nobody is enrolled automatically.

members.notFoundBody: It does not exist, or you are not an officer of this association.

rejectSheet.title: Decline the request from {{name}}?
rejectSheet.description: The person will see that the request was not accepted, with your reason if you give one. They can ask again in {{days}} days.

removeSheet.title: Remove {{name}} from the association?
removeSheet.description: The person will leave the member list and will read your reason. They can only ask again with an administrator's agreement.

mine.title: My associations
mine.lead: Your memberships and your requests. Following a page remains a separate gesture: it gives you its news without making you a member.
mine.emptyTitle: You have not asked to join any association yet.
mine.emptyBody: Find an association from your country hub, then ask to join it from its page.

errors.association_not_managed: This association has no team on DIASPORALE yet: no request can be handled for now.
errors.association_already_member: You are already a member of this association.
errors.association_rejoin_blocked: After a removal, a new request is only possible with the officers' agreement.
errors.association_request_too_soon: Your previous request was not accepted: a new request will be possible a little later.
errors.association_not_pending: This request is no longer pending.
errors.association_not_member: This membership is not (or no longer) active.
errors.association_not_removed: This person is not removed from the association.
errors.association_version_conflict: The list changed in the meantime: review it before deciding.
errors.association_admin_required: This action is up to a page administrator.
errors.association_self_removal: You cannot remove yourself: use “Leave the association”.
errors.association_reason_required: A removal needs a reason: please be more specific.
